pv7:1.1: Pañcaputtakhādakapetavatthu chattaṃ Naggā dubbaṇṇarūpāsi duggandhā pūti vāyasi makkhikāhi parikiṇṇā kā nu tvaṃ idha tiṭṭhasī ti. || ||
pv7:2.1: Ahaṃ bhadante petī 'mhi duggatā Yamalokikā pāpakammaṃ karitvāna petalokaṃ ito gatā. || ||
pv7:3.1: Kālena satta puttāni sāyaṃ satta punāpare vijāyitvāna khādāmi te pi nā honti me alaṃ. || ||
pv7:4.1: Pariḍayhati dhūmāyati khudāya hadayaṃ mama nibbutiṃ nādhigacchāmi aggidaḍḍheva ātape ti. || ||
pv7:5.1: Kin nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kataṃ Kissa kammavipākena puttamaṃsāni khādasī ti. || ||
pv7:6.1: Ahū mayhaṃ duve puttā ubho sampattayobbanā sāhaṃ puttabalūpetā sāmikaṃ atimaññisaṃ. || ||
pv7:7.1: Tato me sāmiko kuddho sapattiṃ aññam ānayi sā ca gabbhaṃ alabhittha, tassā pāpaṃ acetayiṃ. || ||
pv7:8.1: Sāhaṃ paduṭṭhamanasā akariṃ gabbhapātanaṃ tassā temāsiko gabbho pūtilohitako pati. || ||
pv7:9.1: Tad' assā mātā kupitā mayhaṃ ñātī samānayi sapathañ ca maṃ kāresi paribhāsāpayī ca maṃ. || ||
pv7:10.1: Sāham ghorañ ca sapathaṃ musāvādaṃ abhāsisaṃ: puttamaṃsāni khādāmi sace taṃ pakataṃ mayā. || ||
pv7:11.1: Tassa kammavipākena musāvādassa cūbhayaṃ puttamaṃsāni khādāmi pubbalohitamakkhitā ti. || ||
